name: 夢の島熱帯植物館
note_en: Opened in 1988 on Yumenoshima. Its domed greenhouses use heat from a nearby waste incineration plant and display tropical plants.

name: 東京都虹の下水道館
note_en: A public education center on the fifth floor of the Ariake Water Reclamation Center, with hands-on exhibits about sewerage work.

name: 有明水再生センター
note_en: A large wastewater treatment facility in Ariake; tours require advance booking.

name: アクアシティお台場「屋上・上層テラス」
note_en: Free upper-level terraces at Aqua City Odaiba with views across Tokyo Bay.

name: 有明ガーデン「屋上・ガーデンテラス」
note_en: A free outdoor garden terrace on a large mixed-use complex in Ariake.

name: 東京ビッグサイト「屋外デッキ・上層テラス」
note_en: Outdoor decks and upper terraces of the large exhibition complex; public access varies by event.

name: 有明客船ターミナル
note_en: A public passenger terminal and waiting space on the Ariake waterfront.

name: 大阪南港フェリーターミナル
note_en: A ferry terminal on Sakishima with large harbor structures and connecting passages.

name: 神戸六甲アイランドフェリーターミナル
note_en: A long-distance ferry terminal on the planned island of Rokko Island.

name: 北九州空港
note_en: An airport terminal on a man-made island off Kitakyushu.

name: 日本科学未来館
name_en: Miraikan — The National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation
note_en: Opened in 2001 as a science communication center. Miraikan is fully closed for renovation from October 1, 2026, with reopening planned for April 23, 2027.
status: 2026年10月〜2027年4月 全館休館予定

name: 青海フロンティアビル
note_en: A 1996 waterfront office building with a public entrance and atrium connecting surrounding routes.

name: 有明フロンティアビル
note_en: A 1996 office complex with a station-linked deck and public atrium.

name: 台場フロンティアビル
note_en: Opened in 1995; its shared ground floors and atrium form an indoor route through the waterfront business district.

name: 神戸どうぶつ王国
note_en: An indoor and outdoor animal and plant facility on Port Island, including tropical greenhouse spaces.

name: Zepp Tokyo
note_en: A large live music venue in Aomi that closed on January 1, 2022.

name: ヴィーナスフォート
note_en: A shopping complex with indoor streets styled after a European town. It closed on March 27, 2022.

name: MEGA WEB
note_en: Toyota’s former exhibition and test-drive facility in Aomi. It closed on December 31, 2021.
